head.h1: Private Chef & Catering in DIFC — What It Costs and How to Book

opening_paragraph: A private chef in DIFC brings restaurant-grade cooking to your apartment, with private dining from AED 700 per person. myCHEF pairs you with a vetted chef who plans the menu, shops, cooks in your kitchen, serves each course and clears everything away — so you host the evening without ever leaving the table. DIFC is a district of high-floor residences stacked above the trading floors, so most guests the chef cooks for here are finance professionals and residents of Dubai's financial centre. Send your date and address, and during our published business hours you'll hear back promptly with a chef match and an itemised proposal.

The chef cooks bespoke menus across Arabic , Mediterranean , Italian , Indian and Pan-Asian cuisines, and every one can be made halal , vegetarian or vegan, with an allergen-aware approach to dietary requirements. Gluten-free options are available on request, subject to partner confirmation and an allergen review for the specific booking. Tell us the mood — a multi-course tasting dinner, a shared Levantine feast, a canapé reception — and the chef writes the menu to match your guest list and any dietary needs. Seasonal produce, a considered wine or mocktail pairing and a signature dessert are all on the table. Browse sample menus for a starting point, then adjust freely; nothing is locked until you approve the final menu and the itemised quote that goes with it.

add_block.new_heading: What does a private chef in DIFC include?
new_paragraphs: A private chef DIFC booking is a full service, not just cooking — menu design, ingredient sourcing, on-site cooking, plated or family-style service and a spotless kitchen at the end are all part of it. Your personal chef arrives with the mise en place done, works around your appliances, and brings service staff for larger tables so nobody at the party is refilling plates. For smaller gatherings a single home chef handles both kitchen and pass; for a bigger dinner party we add servers and, if you want it, a bar or drinks station. Everything is priced up front in your proposal — there are no surprise line items, and the equipment, serviceware and clean-up are included. Whether you want a quiet supper for two or a standing reception, the format flexes to the room and the occasion.

add_block.new_heading: Private chef DIFC for corporate dinners, celebrations and apartment parties
new_paragraphs: DIFC bookings split three ways: polished corporate dining, milestone celebrations, and relaxed private apartment parties. As a finance and gallery district, DIFC event catering here leans toward boardroom lunches, client dinners and gallery-style receptions, where presentation matters as much as the food. For personal occasions we cover birthdays, engagements and anniversary dinners — the kind of DIFC dinner party catering that turns an apartment into the venue. Whether it's a DIFC apartment or a nearby villa, our catering scales from an intimate table to a full-floor gathering, and we can build a seated menu, a grazing spread or live stations to suit. Corporate hosts often book us to run the whole evening so their team can focus on guests; families book us so nobody spends the celebration in the kitchen. Every DIFC party catering brief is matched to a chef who suits that specific style of event.

add_block.new_heading: Which DIFC buildings and residences do you serve?
new_paragraphs: We cover the whole district and the streets around it, so a private chef near DIFC is rarely more than a short drive away. That includes Gate Village and the DIFC art district, the Index Tower and Sky Gardens residences, and the Central Park towers, along with adjacent communities. Because these are secured towers, we arrange building access and the security sign-in in advance and coordinate the service lift for equipment, so the villa chef or in-villa chef DIFC setup runs on schedule with no lobby delays. We confirm parking, kitchen layout and any building rules before the day, and the chef arrives early to set up quietly. If your address sits just outside the district, we still serve it — just share the exact location when you enquire.

We are honest about it, too: no system removes every risk, so we match each event to the chef well suited to it, which is how we earn a name as one of the best and most trusted options for luxury private dining in DIFC.

For a fine-dining occasion like this, that might be Ahmed Al-Rashid , who brings 18+ years across Dubai, London and Paris in classical French technique. He designs each menu as a collaboration with the host, every course timed, seasoned and served to exacting standards. We have delivered intimate villa dinners and large celebrations across Dubai's communities. Covers private chef difc; client reviews go up as events are delivered.

new_paragraphs: How much does a private chef cost in DIFC?
Private dining in DIFC starts from about AED 700–950 per person, depending on guest count, menu and service level. Larger groups come down per head; send your numbers for an exact quote.
Which parts of DIFC do you serve?
All of DIFC — Gate Village and the DIFC art district, Index Tower and Sky Gardens residences and the surrounding streets — plus nearby Dubai communities. Confirm your exact address when you enquire.
What's included?
Everything from menu planning to the chef, the service staff, the plating and the cleanup — one team covers all of it, and it's all itemised in your quote.
How do I book?
Booking is clear: share your date, guest count and address; we match a vetted chef and send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.
Can you cater a DIFC corporate dinner or boardroom event?
Yes — DIFC event catering is one of our most-requested formats, from boardroom lunches and client dinners to gallery-style receptions, all cooked on site by a vetted chef.
Do you offer halal, vegetarian and vegan menus in DIFC?

Yes. Every DIFC menu can be built halal, vegetarian or vegan across Arabic, Mediterranean, Italian, Indian and Pan-Asian cuisines. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
Can you handle building access and security at DIFC towers?
Yes. We arrange building access and the security sign-in for towers such as Index Tower, Sky Gardens and the Central Park residences, so the chef and equipment arrive without hold-ups.
For private chef difc, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

Once you approve the menu and quote, the chef confirms the shopping list, we arrange building access, and on the day the team handles cooking, service and cleanup end to end. add_block.new_heading: How much does a private chef in DIFC cost?
new_paragraphs: DIFC private chef cost starts from AED 700 per person and scales with the size of your table. Intimate dinners for two sit nearer AED 950–1,300 per head because a full chef's evening is shared between fewer guests; six guests come to around AED 750–1,000 each; and ten or more start from AED 700 per person. The final figure depends on the menu, the number of courses and the service level — a seated tasting dinner costs more per head than a relaxed buffet. There are no hidden charges: shopping, cooking, service, serviceware and clean-up are all in the quote.
